flash.why: Flash Player's API not implemented yet, each small enough to take on alone.

media.why: Flash Player's streaming media, not implemented yet: NetStream, RTMFP groups, StageVideo, DRM and remote SharedObjects, which want a media pipeline and a server protocol.

textEngine.why: Flash Player's text engine (flash.text.engine), not implemented yet: a layout engine of its own.

stage3D.why: Flash Player's Stage3D (flash.display3D), not implemented yet: Stage3D.ts gives no Context3D, as Flash without a GPU.

shaders.why: Flash Player's Pixel Bender shaders, not implemented yet: a shader compiler of their own.

authoring.why: The authoring tool's, debugger's, profiler's and test automation's API (adobe.utils, flash.sampler, flash.profiler, flash.debugger, flash.automation): a release player in a browser answers none of it.

air.why: AIR's API, which Flash Player lacks: an [API] version of AIR's alone on the member or its class, or a class only AIR has (flash.filesystem, flash.data, flash.html, flash.desktop but Clipboard, NativeWindow, NativeMenu, URLRequestDefaults, Updater). A SWF for the browser does not call them.
